watchOS 27.2 will be released next month, bringing several new Apple Watch features, and leaker pdfu has also discovered a major change to the screenshot experience.

New screenshot experience in watchOS 27.2 code is taken from iPhone

Leaker pdfu has recently begun sharing multiple details discovered from Apple's code. For example, he was the first person to discover the Readiness App in watchOS 27, and yesterday he was also the first to leak the Siri AI interface on the HomePod.

pdfu revealed in a new post today that the watchOS 27.2 beta contains code related to a redesigned Apple Watch screenshot experience.

Currently, taking a screenshot on Apple Watch only causes the screen to flash briefly, and then the screenshot is saved to your Photos library.

The new screenshot process mimics the current practice on iPhone and iPad, allowing you to immediately choose to share or delete the screenshot.

It is currently unknown whether Apple plans to include this change in the upcoming watchOS 27.2 beta, or whether it still needs more time to develop. However, if it ultimately fails to appear in watchOS 27.2, we will very likely see this feature on Apple Watch in the near future.

What do you think of the new screenshot experience leaked in watchOS 27.2? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
